children: N-able, Inc. (
), a global cybersecurity company delivering end-to-end business resilience, and SentinelOne® (

), the AI Security leader, today announced an expansion of their longstanding partnership at OneCon 2026, SentinelOne's annual customer conference. Building on years of collaboration, the expanded partnership broadens the cybersecurity capabilities available beyond the endpoint detection and response (EDR) to cover an expanding attack surface, including AI, cloud, identities, and managed response alongside N-able Unified Endpoint Management, Adlumin Security Operations and Cove Data Protection. N-able is now also able to deliver SentinelOne FedRAMP solutions.

Together, N-able and SentinelOne help organizations strengthen security across an ever-growing attack surface by harnessing AI to deliver a comprehensive approach to cyber defense and overall business resilience. These capabilities span three key AI roles: prevention and containment, investigation and triage, and AI governance.

“Security teams don't need more complexity, they need faster and more precise outcomes aided by AI-powered remediation with human-in-the-loop,” said Laura DuBois, General Manager, N-able UEM. “Our expanded relationship with SentinelOne brings together AI-powered security and business resilience through a single, trusted partner, helping customers reduce risk, respond faster, and recover with confidence.”

“AI is creating enormous opportunities, but it also requires a new approach to security,” said Bryce Grow, SVP, Global Channel and MSP at SentinelOne. “Together with N-able, we’re empowering organizations to embrace the transformative benefits of AI, while giving them the tools, intelligence, automation and expertise needed to defend this new and expanding attack surface at the speed and scale AI requires.”
The expanded SentinelOne portfolio available through N-able includes:
AI-powered endpoint detection and response (EDR):

Singularity™ Complete uses behavioral AI to help prevent and contain threats at the endpoint, with investigation capabilities through Purple AI® and deeper incident analysis through RemoteOps Forensics.
AI security and governance:

SentinelOne Prompt Security inspects prompts, file uploads, and responses in real time, helping detect and redact sensitive information before it reaches an AI model and helping defend against AI-specific risks such as prompt injection and jailbreak attempts.
Agentic investigation and automated response:
Purple AI helps translate alerts into findings, summaries, and timelines, while Singularity Hyperautomation orchestrates security workflows and initiates Purple AI Agentic Investigations.
Protection beyond the endpoint:

Opens the full, comprehensive attack surface coverage of the Singularity Platform to introduce AI, cloud, identity security options in ways that cover more attack vectors and prevent lateral movement.

N-able UEM solutions broaden the cybersecurity footprint delivered with these new offerings by ensuring visibility across the attack surface, managing and ensuring security tools are deployed and monitored effectively, and delivering Shadow AI visibility across the organization.

Through the relationship, N-able also supports SentinelOne FedRAMP offerings for eligible U.S. government agencies, contractors, and other organizations with stringent public-sector security requirements.

The accelerated partnership is backed by N-able teams trained to the SentinelOne standard, within one commercial contract and support line across the resilience stack. To learn more, visit https://www.n-able.com/blog/ai-speed-attacks-beyond-the-endpoint.
